limitations: This is an incomplete collection of EPFO employee/staff benefits, not EPF member benefits. Pay level, cadre, posting, eligibility and approving authority must be checked separately.
A central-government OM enclosed with an EPFO letter is not assumed to establish EPFO adoption from the OM date. Issue-date filtering does not resolve retrospective applicability.

Medical reimbursement, CS(MA), CGHS and fixed medical allowance are distinct regimes. Medical originals remain unverified in this first collection; legacy hybrid results do not certify eligibility, amounts or sanction authority.

The original 15 October 2024 order expressly supersedes the 1 October 2024 and 9 December 2022 orders. Its complete conditions and any later revisions must still be checked; chronological comparison alone is not used as a supersession rule.
OCR can lose table cells. The 1 October 2024 briefcase table was visually transcribed; the original scan remains available. No employee is assigned an allowance solely from a matching pay level.
